worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that both $x$ and $y$ appear in each equation. 
The variable $x$ does not appear in the first equation, but this just means its coefficient is $0.$ So, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}0x-6y=4 \\ 3x+5y\,=-7\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & -6 \\ 3 & 5\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -7\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & -6 \\ 3 & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -7\end{aligned}].
$$
